_readme: Character + fight model for minmax.py. Every value marked PLACEHOLDER should be replaced with a number read off your own level 30 hunter (naked, talents on). See README.md 'Calibrating'.

character._base_hp: PLACEHOLDER - naked HP minus 10 x naked stamina
character._base_mana: PLACEHOLDER - naked mana minus 15 x naked intellect
character._base_rap: PLACEHOLDER - naked ranged AP minus naked agility (and minus Careful Aim's int bonus)
character._hp_mult: 1.05 for Tauren, or add any % health talents you take

talents._careful_aim: Forever MM talent: +20% of Intellect as Attack Power per rank. Wowhead lists it as 'Attack Power'; check in game whether ranged AP moves when you add Int.

ratings._agi_per_crit_pct: PLACEHOLDER - measure it: note crit %, equip/remove a known +Agi item, divide the agi change by the crit change
ratings._agi_per_dodge_pct: PLACEHOLDER - measure it the same way using dodge %

fight._duel_length_sec: How long your typical duel lasts. The main knob for Int vs Agi: longer duels make mana worth more.
fight._weapon_dps: Used only if an item row for the ranged slot has no dps value
fight._shot_dps: PLACEHOLDER - extra DPS from your mana shots (Arcane, Serpent, Aimed, Multi) on top of Auto Shot while you have mana
fight._shot_mana_per_sec: PLACEHOLDER - mana/sec those shots cost. Total mana-shot spend divided by duel time
fight._shot_ap_coeff: Extra shot DPS per point of AP (Aimed/Multi scale with weapon damage + AP, so they gain from AP too)
fight._opponent_physical_frac: Share of incoming damage that armor and dodge can reduce. Rogue/warrior/hunter about 0.9, mage/lock/priest about 0.1
fight._fsr_out_frac: Share of the duel spent outside the 5-second rule (no mana spent for 5s). Spirit regen only works then
fight._spirit: Classic hunter regen: spirit/5 + 15 mana per 2s tick outside the 5-second rule

_weights_override: Optional: {"sta":1,"agi":0.6,...} to skip the model and use plain stat weights instead
